label: tissue
definition: Sample material taken directly from an organism, such as a biopsy, explant or dissected organ, rather than grown in culture.

label: cell culture
definition: Sample material consisting of cells grown in vitro, outside the organism they came from.

label: cell line
definition: A cell culture derived from an established cell population that can be propagated over many passages.

label: organoid
definition: A three-dimensional multicellular structure grown in vitro from stem or progenitor cells that self-organises to reproduce aspects of an organ's architecture and function.
